description: This is a test class for the MembershipDao class, containing unit tests for CRUD operations and other membership-related functionalities in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MembershipDaoTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing MembershipDao functionalities such as add, edit, retrieve, delete, and search for memberships within the system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Setup method initializing the MembershipDao instance and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testAddMembership
methods.description: Tests adding a new membership and verifies it is saved correctly.

methods.name: testEditMembership
methods.description: Tests editing an existing membership and verifies the update.

methods.name: testGetMembershipList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the membership list with filters.

methods.name: testGetMembershipById
methods.description: Tests fetching a membership by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteMemberships
methods.description: Tests deletion of memberships by IDs and verifies correct deletion.

methods.name: testDeleteWrongRecord
methods.description: Tests deletion with non-existing IDs to ensure proper handling.

methods.name: testIsExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Tests checking for existing membership names, case-insensitive and trimmed inputs.
